name_reason: Compliant fd2_<domain=ui_menu>_<descriptor> name. '_main' is a semantic suffix distinguishing the default/primary chapter-intro menu from its two siblings (fd2_run_chapter_intro_menu_typeB / _typeC in the same file), not an address residue (no hex). Accurately reflects purpose: the default shop-style chapter-intro selection screen.
purpose: Default/primary chapter-intro menu: the between-chapters BG-image + dialog selection screen (buy/sell/equip/give item plus continue-to-next-chapter), with fade-in setup, a money panel, a 4-way commit/cancel menu loop, and a scaled pose-out exit animation.
logic_summary: Reads the chapter category meta-byte (via fd2_get_chapter_intro_metadata_entry on current_chapter_id) for later pose-table indexing. Picks the FDOTHER BG-image idx by chapter_transition_state @ [0x5412B] (3->0x1D, 5->0x3F, else 0x0C), loads+fades it in, paints the speaker portrait (portrait_id_table[state]), renders the gold panel both live (0xA76C5/0xA7BD0) and into the slide-snapshot shadow buffer (+0x76C5/+0x7BD0), then shows the greeting dialog (idx 0x1F5 when chapter_transition_state==1, else 0x1B8). Resets saved shop cursor/scroll, then loops: restore cursor, open anim, run the shared 4-way input loop, save cursor on commit, close anim, refresh the 12-byte party roster into menu_visible_item_count, slide-out; on commit dispatch by cursor (0=buy,1=sell,2=equip,else=give) and re-show greeting (0x1F7 when state==1, else 0x1B8). Loops while commit==1; cancel(-1) exits. Exit: blit BG, fade to black, 11-frame (iVar5 10..0) nearest-neighbour pose-out scaling pose_bitmap via fd2_blit_scaled_chapter_pose (table_off = cursor_state + chapter_meta_byte*6; y-row table -0x96/+0x5000 feeds the X arg, x-column table -100/+0x3200 feeds the Y arg), committing each frame from the large game-state buffer and ramping brightness; finally free the BG atlas and return (chapter_transition_state==0).

params.name: pose_bitmap
params.semantics: Far pointer (as uint32) to the caller-allocated 64000-byte VGA backdrop snapshot. The caller fd2_chapter_transition_with_intro does pose_bitmap=malloc(64000); memmove(pose_bitmap,0xA0000,64000) before the intro zoom-in, then passes it here. This fn only reads it as the source bitmap for the pose-out animation (fd2_blit_scaled_chapter_pose); the caller owns and frees it.
params.reason: Accurate and address-free; matches the caller's own naming of the same buffer (pose_bitmap). It is the bitmap source for the scaled chapter-pose outro.

returns.semantics: 1 when chapter_transition_state @ [0x5412B] == 0 (start-game flag), else 0. Note: for state 0 the caller actually routes to typeB, so via this path the result is effectively 0; the flag is computed unconditionally and returned through the shared epilogue.

reads_globals: data_fd2_chapter_intro_menu_cursor_state @ 0x5412B (chapter_transition_state: BG idx, portrait, greeting, return flag)
data_fd2_ui_slide_bg_snapshot_buf_ptr @ 0x53C5F (shadow buffer base for money panel)
data_fd2_chapter_intro_portrait_pose_y_row_table @ 0x52635 (byte[18] pose scale, feeds blit X arg)
data_fd2_chapter_intro_portrait_pose_x_column_table @ 0x52647 (byte[18] pose scale, feeds blit Y arg)
writes_globals: data_fd2_ui_menu_screen_sprite_atlas_buf_ptr @ 0x54147 (loaded fresh per intro screen, freed + nulled on exit)
data_fd2_ui_menu_cursor_idx @ 0x53C57 (set to stored_cursor each loop iteration; read back for dispatch)
data_fd2_ui_menu_visible_item_count @ 0x5413F (set to live roster count each iteration)
comment_original_issue: Both the src comment and the Ghidra plate misattributed the greeting-dialog selector to chapter id 1 (src: 'idx 0x1F5 for chapter 1'; plate: 'greeting_idx = (current_chapter_id == 1) ? 0x1F5 : 0x1B8'). The disassembly tests CMP dword ptr [0x5412B],0x1 at 0x2E45C and 0x2E55D, i.e. the selector is chapter_transition_state == 1, NOT current_chapter_id. The source code body itself was correct (uses data_fd2_chapter_intro_menu_cursor_state == 1); only the comments were wrong.
notes: Comment-only fix: corrected greeting-selector misattribution (chapter_transition_state==1, not chapter id 1) in both src comment and Ghidra plate; verified against disasm (CMP [0x5412B],1 @ 0x2E45C / 0x2E55D). Source code body, types, control flow, and constants left untouched. Caller fd2_chapter_transition_with_intro @ 0x2D093 confirms pose_bitmap is a caller-owned 64000-byte VGA snapshot passed for the scaled pose-out outro. Name and parameter both compliant -> keep.
